# fluss-go v0.2.0-beta.1

This is the first fluss-go beta for Apache Fluss 1.0. It intentionally ends
support for Apache Fluss 0.9.1 and is not wire-compatible with that cluster
line.

## Upgrade

- Apache Fluss 0.9.1 users must remain on fluss-go `v0.1.0-beta.11`.
- Upgrade the cluster to Apache Fluss 1.0 before moving the application to
  fluss-go `v0.2.0-beta.1`.
- Keep the root module and any HDFS, OSS, OpenTelemetry, or S3 adapter module
  on the same `v0.2.0-beta.1` release.
- Review the [v0.2 migration guide](https://github.com/pletorco/fluss-go/blob/v0.2.0-beta.1/docs/migration-v0.2.md)
  before rollout.

```sh
go get github.com/pletorco/fluss-go@v0.2.0-beta.1
go get github.com/pletorco/fluss-go/adapters/s3@v0.2.0-beta.1
go mod tidy
```

## Highlights

- Imports the canonical Apache Fluss 1.0 protocol, API, error, and version
  baseline with recorded upstream provenance.
- Uses Fluss 1.0 server-side KV scan sessions with bounded response bytes,
  ordered sequences, terminal detection, cancellation, and explicit cleanup.
- Exposes database alteration, cluster health, remote-log manifest listing,
  active KV snapshot listing, and table bucket-count alteration.
- Preserves leader, replica, ISR, epoch, remote-data, and actual table or
  partition bucket-count metadata and sends authoritative routing counts.
- Handles Fluss 1.0 KV storage pressure with observable write results and
  bounded cooperative throttling.
- Updates existing log and KV data paths to their Fluss 1.0 negotiated
  versions, including filtered log completion.
- Updates Arrow-Go to 18.8.0, Goldmark to 1.8.6, AWS SDK core to 1.47.0, and
  the AWS S3 client to 1.113.1.

The exact supported surface and live proof are documented in the
[Fluss 1.0 feature matrix](https://github.com/pletorco/fluss-go/blob/v0.2.0-beta.1/README.md#fluss-10-feature-matrix)
and [live evidence matrix](https://github.com/pletorco/fluss-go/blob/v0.2.0-beta.1/docs/live-evidence.md).

## Deliberate boundaries

Arrow predicate pushdown and historical physical-partition routing for lake
workflows are not supported in this beta. Native Iceberg, Lance, and Paimon
planning remains application-owned. This release is still a pure-Go client and
does not link or wrap the Fluss Rust core.

## Verification

The release candidate is validated with unit, golden, fuzz-smoke, race,
generation, API, documentation, security, storage-adapter, and live Fluss 1.0
checks. The live suite uses Apache Fluss 1.0.0 commit
`5c07f88e50a8ff41b0ebc214a0458e5dba60be37` and image digest
`sha256:ff461b45438033da4fd1c2556d3f978f3603bb3632fe075c2bd57388339a58cb`.

No release tag should be created until the release-preparation pull request is
approved and merged.
